# The declared names held back, for tests/test_declared_holdbacks.py, which says what holds each reason to the tree.
# One `<name> | <reason>` per line, sorted. A declared name not listed is held by something the tree shows: an
# import here or by Discodon (tests/fixtures/host_imports/discodon.txt), a shipped page, or a declared signature.
#
#   discodon-tests-only  Discodon's tests import it and nothing else does: no page names it, no declared signature
#                        reaches it. It goes provisional once Discodon re-pins without it.
#   port                 A declared protocol or abstract class, which a host implements. Every one is listed.
#   unreached            Declared, and nothing imports, names or reaches it. None.
#
# Computed 2026-11-06 over this tree at a3f15bfd8 and Discodon develop at e5a7f2a56 (2026-11-03): a Discodon test is
# a file under tests/, a conftest.py or a test_*.py; the rest is its production code, which also reads the three
# seed defaults (gen.EVAL_BOUNDARY_GEN_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT, gen.EVAL_PROPOSER_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT,
# analysis.EVAL_ANALYSIS_GEN_DEFAULT) by name. 24 discodon-tests-only, 31 port, 0 unreached.
